title: Announcing importmap-update: automated dependency updates for importmap-rails
partialText: Dependabot keeps your gems current, but it doesn't know about the JavaScript packages pinned in your Rails importmap. We're releasing a GitHub Action that opens pull requests for the ones that are outdated or vulnerable.

title: Designers already think in React
partialText: A senior designer's diary on picking up React Native. This entry starts with an argument about padding and ends up in the React docs, where three of the five steps in "Thinking in React" described work I already do. Variants are props. The layers panel is a hierarchy. The gap is that a Figma file shows every state at once, and code has to pick one.
